description: Main source code for Bluetooth periodic advertising synchronization demo using Zephyr RTOS, involving scanning, syncing, responding, and connection management.

methods.name: sync_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked upon successful synchronization to periodic advertising, sets subevents for sync.

methods.name: term_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when synchronization terminates, logs reason.

methods.name: recv_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving a response, responds with local address if not connected.

methods.name: connected_cb
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection event, references connection and signals semaphore.

methods.name: disconnected_cb
methods.description: Handles disconnection event, unreferences connection and signals semaphore.

methods.name: data_cb
methods.description: Parses advertisement data to extract device name.

methods.name: scan_recv
methods.description: Handles received scan data, filters for specific device name, initiates sync upon detection.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth, scanning, creating sync, and managing connection lifecycle.
